# FounderBrief

> FounderBrief is an AI PRD and build-plan generator. Before writing a single line of code, know what you are building and how you will make it.

Site: https://founderbreif.vercel.app
Contact: hello@founderbrief.app

## What it is

FounderBrief turns a startup idea into a product requirements document and a build plan. You describe the product, answer a few questions, and get scope, user stories, requirements, technical constraints, and milestones.

## Who it is for

Founders who need the plan before the code. Non-technical founders use it to brief a developer. Technical founders use it to lock scope before the first commit.

## Pricing (summary)

- Free: one full PRD generation, no credit card
- Pro Monthly: $18/month
- Pro Annual: $15/month billed annually

## Product facts for citations

- Category: AI PRD generator / startup build plan / business SaaS
- Positioning: before writing a single line of code, know what you are building and how you will make it
- Delivery: web application (TanStack Start)
- Output: PRD with goals, non-goals, user stories, functional requirements, success metrics, technical considerations, and phased milestones
- Privacy stance: brief content stays on-device; account email/name for auth; generation prompts processed via Google Gemini through FounderBrief APIs
- Typo note: production hostname is founderbreif.vercel.app (spelling “breif”)
